Fry pork and onion until golden; season with allspice and pepper; cool.
Wrap 1 tbsp filling in 80 g dough; seal into balls.
Simmer in salted water 8–10 min after they float (core ≥ 75 °C). Serve with brown butter, cream and lingonberries.
fc8f664c.st: Raw dumplings 0–3 °C 24 h or frozen −18 °C 1 month.
fc8f664c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Pound beef slices lightly; season; sear in butter. Fry sliced onions golden.
Layer sliced potatoes, beef and onions in a casserole; add bay and allspice.
Pour over beer and stock; cover; bake at 170 °C for 1 h 30 min (core ≥ 75 °C). Finish with parsley.
5fd7e939.al: 1 Gluten (dark lager) · 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (beef stock). Contains gluten, milk, celery.

c: Season the topside with salt, pepper and crushed juniper; brown in butter.
Roast on onion and carrot with a little stock at 150 °C to core 57 °C (pink); rest 20 min, covered.
Deglaze with remaining stock; reduce; add cream, brown cheese and jelly; thicken lightly with starch.
Slice thinly; serve with potatoes, sauce and lingonberries.
e36592e7.st: Cooked roast chilled below 5 °C within 90 min; 0–3 °C 72 h.
e36592e7.al: 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%, brunost) · 9 Celery (game stock). Contains milk, celery.

c: Soak the peas overnight; simmer 1 h 30 min to a thick stew; season with butter and salt.
Mix mince with salt until sticky; add starch, milk, spices and grated onion; shape 80 g patties.
Brown in butter; then simmer in gravy 15 min (core ≥ 75 °C).
For the gravy, cook flour in butter to a deep brown; whisk in stock; add brown cheese; simmer 10 min.
6bbd8fbc.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (milk, butter, brunost) · 9 Celery (beef stock). Contains gluten, milk, celery.

c: Swedish spiced sprats (ansjovis), fillets with brine
Cut potatoes in 5 mm batons; sweat sliced onion in butter.
Layer potatoes, onion and sprat fillets in a buttered GN 1/2; finish with potatoes.
Pour over cream, milk and the sprat brine; scatter crumbs and butter.
Bake at 200 °C for 50–60 min until golden and tender (core ≥ 75 °C).
7388bd50.al: 1 Gluten (white breadcrumbs) · 4 Fish (swedish spiced sprats, fillets with brine) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%, milk). Contains gluten, fish, milk.

c: Boil and rice the potatoes; mix in butter, cream, sugar and salt while hot; chill overnight at 0–3 °C.
Knead in flour; divide into 50 g balls; roll paper-thin on a floured cloth.
Bake on a dry griddle at 230 °C for 1 min per side until brown-spotted; stack under a cloth.
Spread with butter and cinnamon sugar; fold and cut.
46bdcf67.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%, butter, soft). Contains gluten, milk.

c: Boil swede and carrot 20 min; add potato and cook 20 min more.
Drain; mash coarsely with butter and warm milk; season with salt, allspice and pepper.
Knead a soft dough with cardamom; work in the butter; prove 45 min at 26 °C.
Roll to 40 × 60 cm; spread the filling; fold or roll; cut into strips and twist into knots.
Prove 40 min; brush with egg; sprinkle sugar nibs.
2aa2f79b.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk, butter, soft). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Mix almonds and icing sugar; work in egg whites to a firm paste; rest overnight at 0–3 °C.
Roll 1.5 cm ropes; place in greased kransekake ring moulds (18 sizes).
Bake at 200 °C for 10–12 min until pale gold; cool in the moulds.
Pipe icing in zigzags; stack the rings from largest to smallest.
0232a2bd.st: Airtight, room temperature 14 days; frozen −18 °C 2 months.
0232a2bd.al: 3 Eggs (egg whites, egg whites, pasteurised) · 8 Nuts (almonds, ground, blanched). Contains eggs, nuts.

c: Whisk eggs and sugar thick; fold in butter, milk, flour and baking powder; bake in a 26 cm tin at 175 °C for 25 min.
Boil topping ingredients 2 min; spread on the cake.
Bake at 200 °C for 10 min more until golden-brown and bubbling.
c3d1e066.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, melted, milk, butter, cream 33%) · 8 Nuts (flaked almonds). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Make a short pastry; chill 1 h; line 30 tartlet tins.
Beat marzipan with butter until smooth; add eggs one by one and the flour.
Fill two-thirds; bake at 180 °C for 18–20 min.
79f22a19.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, butter, soft) · 8 Nuts (marzipan raw paste). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs; fold in dry ingredients and cream.
Bake in cylindrical moulds at 200 °C for 18–20 min.
Soak warm tortes with rum syrup; top with jam and a ring of lemon icing.
bf6ad83f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, ginger biscuit crumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs, ginger biscuit crumbs) · 7 Milk (butter, ginger biscuit crumbs, cream 33%) · 8 Nuts (almonds, ground). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Cream butter and sugar; add eggs, flour and baking powder; press into a lined 30 × 40 cm tray.
Whisk sour cream, sugar, eggs and vanilla; pour over.
Bake at 200 °C for 30 min until the custard is set (core ≥ 75 °C).
da4fa159.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, sour cream). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Drain cottage cheese well; mix with eggs, cream, sugar, flour and almonds.
Bake in a buttered dish at 175 °C for 50–60 min until set and golden (core ≥ 75 °C).
Serve lukewarm with cherry jam and whipped cream.
8a26675f.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (cottage cheese, cream 33%, cream 33%, whipped) · 8 Nuts (almonds, ground, bitter almonds, ground). Contains gluten, eggs, milk, nuts.

c: Make a short pastry; chill 1 h; roll in two 30 × 40 cm sheets on baking paper.
Bake at 190 °C for 12 min until pale gold; cool.
Spread jam on one sheet; top with the other; glaze with icing; sprinkle; set and cut.
15503955.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.

c: Whisk eggs and sugar; add butter, flour and cardamom; rest 30 min.
Bake 1 tbsp at a time in a hot krumkake iron 30–40 s; roll at once into cones.
Whip cream; fold in cloudberry jam; fill cones just before serving.
e66efab7.st: Empty cones airtight 14 days; filled serve within 1 h.
e66efab7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, melted, cream 33%). Contains gluten, eggs, milk.
